reason: I buy from the dekkene on my tab and I walk there myself. A few minutes from Tawfeer, why would I pay someone to shop for me? I do not need another person doing what I already do.
objection: I already have my tab at the dekkene, and paying a bag fee on top of the groceries is money I do not have to spare. I do not use WhatsApp lists and I do not know this neighbour.
would_change_my_mind: If the dekkene itself took the order and I could keep my tab with the same man, with no fee per bag.
